title: 商用車空氣煞車概念
summary: 在無壓示意與合成資料中追蹤供氣、控制和摩擦制動，不提供真車調整設定。
summaryEn: Trace supply, control and friction braking in unpressurized schematics and synthetic data without vehicle adjustment settings.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 氣壓制動缸作用力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pneumatic brake-cylinder force: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 氣壓制動缸作用力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pneumatic brake-cylinder force and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為儲氣筒、制動閥與氣缸。相對大氣的壓差作用於活塞；機械倍率、摩擦與回位力另列。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows air reservoir, brake valve and cylinder. Pressure difference acts on the piston; leverage, friction and return forces are separate.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：F=pgauge A；p=.6 MPa、A=.015 m²；計算結果=9000 N。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: F=pgauge A; p=.6 MPa, A=.015 m²; result=9000 N.
steps.failure: 低缸壓可能為洩漏或供壓不足；同時看儲氣與缸壓曲線。
steps.failureEn: Low cylinder pressure may be leakage or inadequate supply; compare reservoir and cylinder traces.
steps.check: 理想9000 N；此假設不是車輛壓力設定或操作指引。 將此判讀連回儲氣筒、制動閥與氣缸的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Ideal force is 9000 N; this assumption is not a vehicle pressure setting or operating instruction. Relate this interpretation to air reservoir, brake valve and cylinder and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ideal-gas reservoir inventory and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為儲氣筒、制動閥與氣缸。固定容積等溫假設下質量變化與絕對壓力差成正比；快速充放氣不一定等溫。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows air reservoir, brake valve and cylinder. At fixed volume and temperature, inventory change follows absolute pressure change; rapid filling need not be isothermal.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：DeltaM=DeltaP V/(R T)；DeltaP=200000 Pa、V=.05 m³、R=287、T=300 K；計算結果=0.11614402 kg。

steps.failure: 溫度回復可能造成壓力下降而非洩漏；同時記錄溫度。
steps.failureEn: Thermal recovery can lower pressure without leakage; record temperature too.
steps.check: 質量差約.116144 kg；絕對壓力與表壓不得混用在氣體狀態式。 將此判讀連回儲氣筒、制動閥與氣缸的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Mass change is about .116144 kg; do not mix absolute and gauge pressure in the state equation. Relate this interpretation to air reservoir, brake valve and cylinder and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
